messages.text: I applied for a refund on my seat cushion while I was still within the deadline, but the staff member rejected it. Surely that first request keeps my refund window open?

messages.text: No. A rejected proposal doesn’t keep the refund window open for a later request. The first proposal was created on November 2, 24 days after delivery on October 9, so it was within the 30-day window. But because it was rejected, a later request must still be made within 30 days of delivery; the rejected proposal doesn’t preserve the deadline (refund-policy/v2/window).
